panels.description: 5G Network & Transport Delay (camera capture to analyzer appsink ingest). Server published.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "application_metrics" and r.app_type == "cctv" and r.cluster == "regional" and (r._field == "net_delay_ms" or r._field == "slicea_net_delay_ms"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: r.app_name + " Net Delay (ms)" }))
  |> yield(name: "net_delay")
